narrationTexts: Confirmed the actual bug and fixed both call sites.
finalText:
**Build's clean now, 0 errors.**

The bump changed the options shape from `retries` to `retryCount`, and left unset feature flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Two call sites hadn't caught up:

- [src/core/options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries` (now `undefined`), crashing on `.toFixed()`. Now reads `options.retryCount`.
- [src/net/retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined` instead of treating it as disabled. Added that case.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the new version, not errors.

Next: nothing.
